本实用新型提供种生物基因检测器具，包括基台、若干透明片和透明盖，基台开设有培养腔，培养腔具有开口，培养腔的底部开设有若干培养槽，每透明片活动设置于培养槽内，透明盖活动设置于基台上，且活动封闭开口，透明盖上开设有若干通孔，每通孔内设置有弹性橡胶，弹性橡胶上开设有进样口。本实用新型保证待测样品和基因芯片接触足够的时间同时，使透明片处于培养槽内，能隔离各透明片，从而避免各透明片上的待测样品间相互影响，且透明盖使得透明片上的待测样品从滴管转移到培养腔内的过程始终与外部环境隔离，避免待测样品受到外界环境的影响，从而令实验精度更高。

A kind of biological gene detection utensilTechnical field

The utility model relates to genetic test field, in particular to a kind of biological gene detects utensil.

Background technique

With the implementation of human genome (sequencing) plan and the fast development of molecular biology related discipline, increasingly More animal, plant, microbial genome sequence are measured, and gene sequence data increases rapidly at an unprecedented rate It is long.In order to study the function that such numerous genes are undertaken in life process, it is necessary to set up novel hybridization and sequencing approach With equipment efficiently, quickly detect to a large amount of hereditary information, analyze.In order to comply with this scientific development requirement, tie The cross disciplines such as microelectronics, physics, chemistry, material science, life science are closed, genetic chip, genetic chip are had investigated (also known as DNA chip, biochip, DNA microarray) will largely (usual battle array density be higher than 400/cm2) probe molecule is by specific Arrangement mode matching hybridization complementary with the detected gene samples molecule progress of label after being fixed on solid carrier support, leads to It crosses the hybridization signal intensities for detecting each probe molecule and then obtains the quantity and sequence information of sample molecule.Presently used base It is carried out on genetic chip mostly for plate glass or silicon chip when carrying out biomolecule reaction because chip is substantially all, It is difficult to ensure affected by environment larger, the evaporation of biological reagent cannot be inhibited, genetic chip humidity cannot be consistent, biology point Son reaction cannot maintain under the best circumstances, this all will lead to the raising of the mispairing ratio between biomolecule, and be unfavorable for The closed preservation of reaction result.

Utility model content

The technical problem to be solved by the utility model is to provide a kind of biological genes to detect utensil.

The technical solution that the utility model solves above-mentioned technical problem is as follows: a kind of biological gene detection utensil, including base Platform, several slidies and transparency cover, the base station offer culture chamber, and the culture chamber has an opening, the culture chamber Bottom offers several culture tanks, and the side wall of each culture tank offers sampling groove, each slide activity setting In in a culture tank, each slide has the first side being oppositely arranged and second side, the slide and first Side is adjacent to have third side, and first side and described second side are connected to the side wall of the culture tank, the slide respectively Third side extend on the sampling groove, the transparency cover is movably set on the base station, and the opening is closed in activity, Several through-holes are offered on the transparency cover, each culture tank of each through-hole on transparency cover and the culture chamber bottom Alignment is arranged one by one, is provided with elastic rubber in each through-hole, an injection port is offered on the elastic rubber.

Further, one end of the transparency cover and the base station are rotatablely connected.

Further, sliding slot is provided on the base station, the side of the transparency cover is slideably positioned in the sliding slot.

Further, the base station wraps around the opening and is provided with limited block, and the transparency cover removable cover is set to institute It states on base station, and the side of the transparency cover is connected to the limited block.

Further, the slide is the one of which in transparent glass sheet, transparent resin sheet and transparent silicon chip.

The beneficial effects of the utility model are: the utility model guarantees that sample to be tested and genetic chip contact time enough Meanwhile it is in a slide in one culture tank, each slide can be isolated, to avoid phase between the sample to be tested on each slide Mutually influence, and transparency cover make the sample to be tested on slide from dropper be transferred to process in culture chamber always with external environment Isolation, avoids influence of the sample to be tested by external environment, to enable experimental precision higher.Meanwhile using traditional slide DNA molecular hybridization is carried out, also facilitates for slide to be placed under times mirror and observe.It, can be easily with hand after being disposed Refer to or the tools such as crow bar penetrate sampling groove to break out slide from culture tank, so that it is more convenient to take out slide.
